title: source-binding-analyzer output
description: Schema for ONE JSONL line written by the source-binding-analyzer subagent (Phase 2d — source binding). Each dispatched agent examines ONE ingested data source against ALL data-driven deck elements and writes one record per element it can say anything about. The deterministic post-pass (merge_validate_analysis.py --mode bind) validates every element_id against element_understanding.jsonl and every candidate column_id against source_catalog.json (fabricated ids are DROPPED), rewrites table/column names canonically from the catalog, and merges candidates across sources into workspace/source_bindings.jsonl.

element_id.description: The deck element this record binds, copied VERBATIM from the elements payload.

source_id.description: The source file this agent examined, copied verbatim from the source payload's source_id.

bindings.description: One entry per deck column (or chart series) from the elements payload. Include EVERY column of the element — a column you cannot bind still gets an entry with resolution clarify / derived / no-match.

deck_column.description: The deck-side column/series name, copied verbatim from the elements payload.

candidates.description: Ranked source-column candidates FROM THIS SOURCE ONLY, best first. Empty when resolution is derived / no-match. Every column_id MUST exist in the source payload you read — a fabricated id is dropped by the post-pass.

table.description: Catalog table/sheet name (echoed; the post-pass rewrites it canonically from the catalog).

column.description: Catalog column name (echoed; canonicalized by the post-pass).

score.description: Honest match strength. >=0.7 means you would defend this bind; a name collision with an incompatible format must NOT score high.

resolution.description: confirm: a strong candidate exists (top score >=0.7). clarify: plausible but ambiguous candidates — a human must pick. derived: the deck column is computed (role=derived — Total, Excess Return); it has NO single source column by design. no-match: nothing plausible in this source.

note.description: One line — what would settle a clarify, or why the best name-match was rejected.

confidence.description: Honest confidence in this element's bindings as a set (not per candidate).

rationale.description: One to three sentences: which table(s) this element maps to and what drove or blocked the match.
